title: MacroPulse Alert
message:
BTC fell to $64,034 on Jul 25 → $87M BTC / $312M total crypto liquidations; stabilised ~$64,320.
All 12 assets within alert thresholds (dashboard 20:32 UTC Jul 25): BTC +0.2%, Oil +1.1%, Gold +0.07% 24h.
FOMC week: rate decision Jul 29 2pm ET (hold 3.5–3.75% expected); GDP advance + PCE + BOE on Jul 30.
